scientific_integrity: Proof includes explicit upper and lower Bowen-growth estimates; finite numerical tests are not a proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only homeomorphisms; no differentiable regularity at a fixed circle, preservation of area, or minimality is asserted. Covers every polynomial-entropy exponent strictly between one and two and no endpoints or larger values. Historical priority under slow-entropy terminology remains a risk.
title: Fractional polynomial entropy with singleton rotation set on the two-torus
